Ph.D. in Geology
Academic Program Guide for Ph.D. Students (Effective Fall 2025)
Department of Geology (geology@rowan.edu) Approved March 2020
Rowan University Graduation Requirements for those in the Ph.D. in Geology
• Students must complete at least 72 semester hours (sh) of coursework that apply to their Rowan University degree, or a minimum of 42 credits of
graduate-level work beyond the master’s degree.
• Satisfy all course requirements listed below.
• Students must have a cumulative GPA of at least 3.0 in Rowan University coursework.
• Successfully pass all parts of the Ph.D. qualification and candidacy examinations with a B or better.
• Successfully defend a Ph.D. dissertation.
Ph.D. Requirements (72 sh)
SUMMARY OF MAJOR REQUIREMENTS
§ 18 sh of Year-One Required Courses, plus Successfully Pass Qualification Examination
§ 18 sh of Year-Two Required Courses, plus Successfully Pass Candidacy Examination

§ Successfully Pass a Dissertation Defense
§ 72 sh total earned
